items.title: Improve loading screen text clarity
items.what: The loading screen text 'Downloading the game' is too small and light to be easily readable on a phone screen (screenshot 1).
items.why: This hurts the player's experience as it may cause frustration or confusion during the loading process.
items.how: Increase the font size and contrast of the loading text to make it more visible.

items.title: Enhance control label visibility
items.what: The labels 'STANCE' and 'TECHNIQUE' below the control joysticks are too small and dim, making them hard to read (screenshot 2).
items.why: This affects the player's ability to understand the controls, potentially leading to confusion or incorrect usage.
items.how: Increase the font size and brightness of the control labels to improve readability.

items.title: Improve move list contrast
items.what: The move list text is very low contrast against the dark background, making it difficult to read (screenshot 6).
items.why: Low contrast text can cause eye strain and make it harder for players to access information about available moves.
items.how: Increase the contrast of the move list text by using a brighter color or adjusting the background.

items.title: Enhance settings text contrast
items.what: The settings menu text is also low contrast, similar to the move list, making it hard to read (screenshot 7).
items.why: This can lead to difficulties in navigating and understanding the settings options.
items.how: Improve the contrast of the settings text by using a more visible color or adjusting the background.

items.title: Adjust fighter composition on screen
items.what: The fighters are positioned too low on the screen, leaving a significant empty space below them (screenshot 2).
items.why: This composition issue can make the game feel unbalanced and less engaging.
items.how: Adjust the camera or fighter positioning to better utilize the screen space and create a more balanced composition.
